p.font: Welcome to the Odoo Garage & Auto Repair Package.

template.div: The definitive all-in-one solution designed to streamline your automotive service business. From the first handshake to the final invoice, manage every repair with precision:
360° View: Complete visibility of customers and their vehicle history.
Smart Scheduling: Fully automated appointment booking to keep your bays full.
Streamlined Workflow: An intuitive interface for technicians to log data in real-time.
Deep Insights: Comprehensive reporting on every intervention and performance metric.
template.p: Seamless Invoicing: Convert interventions to professional invoices with a single click.
By uploading this module's demo data, your database has been filled with a few contacts.
To quickly understand the processes offered by this Odoo package, you can execute the following flows and configure the settings to suit your business.
Of course, this is just an overview of the features included in this package. Feel free to add new apps, delete/modify demo data, and test everything around!

template.p: Easily manage all your customers from the Contact module and link one or multiple vehicles directly using the smart button.
Each vehicle profile gives you quick access to essential details:

li.p: Vehicle Specs: Brand, model, model year, type, etc.
Technical Info: Tire specs, motor block references, and other technical data
Status & Usage: Vehicle status (Active or Downgraded) & latest odometer reading
Automatic Identification: Plate and chassis numbers automatically placed on every quotation, sales order, and invoice

template.p: All linked vehicles are also accessible directly from the Fleet Module.
Efficient calendar management is critical for running a garage smoothly and saving valuable time.

A fully automated system often fails because customers don't know the exact mechanical issue or how long the repair will take. Conversely, a completely manual flow wastes too much administrative time. To solve this, we implemented a semi-automated appointment flow:

li.p: The customer contacts the garage and describes their issue.
The administrator estimates the required service duration based on the request.
Odoo sends an appointment invitation to the customer. The customer can reschedule if needed, but only within time slots that have available resources for that exact duration.

template.p: The administrator controls the service duration, while Odoo automates the rest of the scheduling.

li.p: Initial Contact: The customer submits a contact form on the website with details and optional photo attachments.
Task Creation: This automatically creates a new task in the Intervention project.
New Customer: Create the customer, add their vehicle, and link it to the task.
Existing Customer: Select the correct customer profile and their vehicle.
Clarification: If you need additional details, use the Chatter to message the client directly.

Scheduling: Once the request is qualified, select the appropriate appointment type and move the task to the next stage. Odoo will automatically email the client a proposed time slot, which they can reschedule if necessary.

div.p: Set up automated email or SMS reminders on the appointment type to notify customers a few hours or days before their service.

li.p: Define your appointment preferences in the Appointment app. Keep these key settings in mind:
Resources: Resources can be team members or physical equipment. In our demo data, we use available car lifts (Car Lift 1 and Car Lift 2) to set maximum concurrent capacity.
Booking Lead Time (Options Tab): Sets the minimum notice period before a proposed booking date.

Example: If you send a 3-hour appointment link on October 1st, Odoo will propose an appointment starting October 15th based on resource availability. The customer can adjust the date sooner or later based on open slots. This buffer prevents same-day auto-bookings that clients might miss.

ul.li: Handling Emergencies & Long Interventions: Use the Intervention appointment type (in demo data) for urgent repairs or multi-day jobs. Follow the standard web form flow, which blocks out the initial day. If the repair takes longer, manually extend the appointment duration on the calendar.

li.p: You can also manually attach a second resource—such as a Replacement Car—to the appointment so you can easily track vehicle loaner availability and return dates.

ul.li: Handling Phone Appointments: If a customer calls and wants to book directly:

li.p: Create the task, linking the customer and vehicle.
Select the appointment type.
Click the Appointment button to manually book the time slot.
Move the task to the next stage.

template.p: Depending on the customer's needs, you can issue an invoice directly after the service or start with a quotation:

li.p: If a quote is required, click Create Quotation on the task before setting up the appointment.
Send the quotation to the customer for approval (Select the correct vehicle to ensure additional details, such as the license plate and chassis numbers, are automatically added to the quotation.)
Once validated, proceed with the rest of the appointment flow.

p.b: The Sales app offers a variety of flexible features, including:

li.p: Using pre-existing services with defined pricing
Creating custom line items on the fly
Reusing existing quotation or section templates
Adding standard terms and conditions

p.i: Consult the documentation to customize the app to your specific workflow.

template.p: The Intervention Project makes tracking and managing ongoing repairs effortless across every stage:

ul.li: New Requests: Houses all incoming intervention requests that need qualification.

li.p: Link Sent: Contains tasks where an appointment link has been sent to the client.
Prerequisites: The customer’s email and vehicle must be assigned before moving a task to this stage.

Cards are automatically sorted by Priority and Appointment Date. At the end of each day, the administrator can review upcoming jobs for the next day, advance them to the next stage, and assign them to the right mechanic or technician.

ul.li: Use the Vehicle Checked In checkbox to confirm when a car arrives on-site and track how long it has been at the garage. Uncheck or mark Vehicle Checked Out when it departs. For legal compliance, all check-in/check-out timestamps are automatically logged in the Chatter.
Use the status indicator to track spare parts availability. Mark it as Approved once all required parts are in stock and the repair can proceed.
Ensure all technical requirements, customer notes, and vehicle details are documented in the task description for the service team.
To Do: Holds all intervention tasks scheduled to be performed today.
To Be Taken: Once repairs are complete, move the task here. An automated email will notify the client that their vehicle is ready for pickup.
Done: After the client picks up their vehicle, drag the task here and mark the Vehicle Checked Out box.

li.p: Tracked Products: Track exact stock quantities and inventory movements.
Consumables: Treat items as consumables for straightforward pricing, cost tracking, and simplified traceability.
